name: Celica Leticia Le Blanc de la Lumiere
original_name: セリカ レティシア ル ブラン ド ラ ルミエール
source:
Goddess-class magician. A student at the Orleans Academy of Magic.
The daughter of a viscount from a local aristocratic family, the Lumiere family, has produced many famous magicians for generations. She
is engaged to her childhood friend Leon, and although Celica has not been able to express her feelings honestly, they have a heart-to-heart relationship.

She is a genius and beautiful magician, recognized by everyone, and has been certified as a "goddess-class magician," one of the twelve god-class (Twelve Ranks) by the kingdom's Magic Council. As a result, her body is protected by the goddess.
Naturally, she is invincible and undefeated at the academy.
She has a temperament that will mercilessly beat down any male student who flirts with her, even if the opponent is the son of a higher-ranking nobleman, with her lightning magic.

Although she hides it from those around her, since she learned how to masturbate, she indulges in it all day and night in her room. Recently, she has become interested in adult goods.
Furthermore, she is actually a hidden masochist with a desire to submit...
[From DLSite]
